name: taste
description: taste routing and conformance: page and app-screen builds decide a direction from the subject, are rendered and looked at, and stay silent on CSS fixes and non-visual work

scenarios.name: landing page from a brief: direction from the subject, rendered and looked at
scenarios.prompt: Can you build the website for the bakery in agent-suites/fixtures/harbour-bakery? The owner's brief is in the README. One page, static.

judge: The reply states one idea taken from the bakery itself (its harbour, its once-a-day bake, its sell-out hours) and the type, colour and layout choices that carry it.
Every loaf and pastry with its price, the opening days and hours, the address and the reserve-by-text rule appear in the page.
The page was rendered in a browser at a phone and a desktop width after the last edit, and the reply names what the screenshots showed.

scenarios.name: generic page restyle: tells removed, content kept
scenarios.prompt: Our landing page in agent-suites/fixtures/ledger-launch looks like every AI-generated SaaS page out there. Make it look like someone actually designed it for this product. Keep the content.

judge: The gradient text and buttons, glow shadows, glass nav, emoji icons, eyebrow labels and three identical cards are gone from the page.
All features, both price tiers and all three FAQ answers are kept.
The page was rendered and looked at after the last edit, and the reply reports what was checked.

scenarios.name: app screen: questions first, computed from the data
scenarios.prompt: Build the main screen for the crew rota tool in agent-suites/fixtures/crew-rota. The README says what the coxswain needs from it.

judge: The screen renders data/station.json and shows whether today can cover a launch and which days in the week cannot (23, 24 and 27 October).
Training lapsing soon is shown for Loveday Curnow, Aisha Hendry and Morwenna Kitto.
The screen was rendered at a phone and a desktop width after the last edit.

scenarios.name: near miss: one focus-ring CSS defect
scenarios.prompt: Keyboard users can't see which link in the top nav is focused (agent-suites/fixtures/nav-bar). Fix it without changing how it looks for mouse users.

judge: Keyboard focus on nav links gets a visible :focus-visible indicator and the hover style is unchanged.

scenarios.name: near miss: a factual question about a page
scenarios.prompt: Which typefaces and colours does the brand file in agent-suites/fixtures/tidewater-ferries define? Just tell me, no changes.

judge: The reply lists the two typefaces and the five colour tokens from brand.css.

scenarios.name: near miss: a data bug behind a screen
scenarios.prompt: In agent-suites/fixtures/crew-rota, how many of the October launches took more than eight minutes to launch? Work it out from the data file, no changes.

judge: The reply answers two (9 and 11 minutes) from data/station.json.

scenarios.name: personal site: a register chosen on purpose, thesis first
scenarios.prompt: Make my personal website from the notes in agent-suites/fixtures/personal-site. One page, static. I want it to feel like me, not a template.

judge: The reply names the kind of page it built (for example a quiet column, a story, a desktop or a single toy) and the particular from Tomás's notes that earns it.
The first screen states what Tomás cares about (interfaces with weight) in his own voice, readable without clicking, dragging or scrolling.
Every interactive effect on the page demonstrates his craft, and there is at most one signature effect; Tidepool, Spring Lab, Lumen, the talk and both links all appear.
The page was rendered at a phone and a desktop width after the last edit.
